title: Stalks of the presheaf inverse image along a continuous map, with germs
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces and let $\mathcal C$ be the category of abelian groups or the category of commutative rings. Let $\mathcal G$ be a presheaf on $Y$ with values in $\mathcal C$, let $f_p\mathcal G$ be its presheaf inverse image, $f_p\mathcal G(U)=\varinjlim_{V\supseteq f(U)}\mathcal G(V)$, with the morphism $i_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G\to f_*f_p\mathcal G$, $i_{\mathcal G,V}:\mathcal G(V)\to f_p\mathcal G(f^{-1}V)$ the coprojection of index $V$ [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image], and let stalks and germs be as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] (for commutative rings: the colimit $\varinjlim_{W\ni z}\mathcal P(W)$ in commutative rings). Let $x\in X$ and $y=f(x)$. Then there is exactly one morphism $c^p_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G_y\to(f_p\mathcal G)_x$ in $\mathcal C$ such that $c^p_{\mathcal G}(s_y)=(i_{\mathcal G,V}(s))_x$ for every open $V\ni y$ and every $s\in\mathcal G(V)$ (note $x\in f^{-1}V$), and $c^p_{\mathcal G}$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma 008G (lemma-stalk-pullback-presheaf: $(f_p\mathcal G)_x=\operatorname{colim}_{x\in U}\operatorname{colim}_{f(U)\subset V}\mathcal G(V)=\operatorname{colim}_{f(x)\in V}\mathcal G(V)=\mathcal G_{f(x)}$, by cofinality: $U=f^{-1}V$), Lemma 008O (1) (lemma-pullback-abelian-stalk: an isomorphism of abelian groups) and Section 008P (the same formula in a category of algebraic structures); the germ formula is the construction (the composite of the coprojections)
